follow_ups.title: design-language.md L3 Art still describes figurative posters
follow_ups.body: The L3 Art entry in docs/design-language.md describes posters and horizons with hills and plants. packages/ui-kit/agent/flavour.md lists figurative art under do-not-converge, and says design-language.md wins when the two disagree. Reconcile the two documents.

tests.covers_criterion: Criteria 1-11: byte equality with the in-memory build; the drift check, which writes no file; the npm script leaves the tree unchanged; section order; colour roles, purposes and product accents; typography, spacing, radius and motion values that follow the build input; signature components with the bezel card not shipped; one meaning per effect family; every do-not-converge row; no dates or history, with reasons beside do and do-not items; the README row and package files list. Criterion 12 has no test.

result.notes:
I have not run these tests, because I had no way to execute code. From reading the code, each should fail now: the generator, DESIGN.md, the npm script and the README row don't exist. The `files` list already covers `agent/`, so that criterion's test fails only on the README row and the missing file.

Criterion 12 (no CSS or token changes, existing tests still pass) already holds on the current code, so it has no test. Check it with the diff and `npm test`.

This file is also the drift test for criterion 2. The CDR scope names `scripts/design-md-drift.test.mjs`, but my file has to carry the CDR tag. You don't need a second copy.

The CDR doesn't specify the details below, so the tests set them:
1. **Build function:** `scripts/gen-design-md.mjs` exports `buildDesignMd({ tokens } = {})`, which returns a string. `tokens` replaces the parsed `sondalab.tokens.json`. Passing the committed tokens must give the same output as the default. Importing the module and calling it must write nothing.
2. **Changed input:** the test replaces every `shared` font, text, line, space, radius and motion value with a placeholder string. The build must not reject or parse these in a way that throws, including in any rule text or control height derived from them. `$`-prefixed notes are siblings of these groups, not keys inside them.
3. **npm script:** one script must be exactly `node scripts/gen-design-md.mjs`. Adding it to the `gen:tokens` chain is optional and separate. The test runs it in a temporary copy containing only `sondalab.tokens.json`, `package.json`, `scripts/`, `docs/` and `packages/ui-kit/`, so read sources only from those. If you use an "is main module" check, it must work from that path.
4. **Headings:** the nine sections are `##` headings. Their titles must contain: brand + voice; colour; typograph; spacing + radi + "control height"; depth; signature; motion; effect; and "do" + "do-not" (or "don't"), for example "Do and do-not". Subsections use `###` or deeper.
5. **Token lines:** in its section, each token has one line with both the full name (`--sl-space-4`, `--sl-font-sans`, `--sl-text-md`, `--sl-line-tight`, `--sl-radius-lg`, `--sl-motion-fast`) and its verbatim value. Typography covers font, text and line; the spacing section covers space and radius; motion covers motion.
6. **Colour lines:** each role has a line with its name (`bg-canvas` or `--sl-bg-canvas`) and its value for each theme. This works with one row holding all three themes or a table per theme. Light and dark use the default product's baked neutrals plus `tokens.themes`; high contrast uses `tokens.themes["high-contrast"]`. At least one line per role needs two or more words of purpose outside code spans and colour literals. Each registry product ID, including `default` and `daos`, shares a line with its light accent and with its dark accent.
7. **Bezel card:** use the words "bezel card". From their first mention to the next `###` heading, the text must say "chosen" and "not shipped" or "not yet shipped".
8. **Effect families:** each family's name shares a line with its meaning from L6: "something re-resolved", "attention lives here", "this is a physical surface" and "these belong to one another". No line may combine one family's name and meaning with another family's meaning.
9. **Do and do-not:** keep each do-not trait name word for word from `flavour.md`, with at least three words of reason on the same line. Every bullet or table data row in this section needs at least five words outside code spans, on its first line. There must be more items than the do-not rows alone, so a do list is required.
10. **History:** the test rejects ISO dates, owner-ruling phrases, `ui-kit N.N`, "since", "until" or "before" followed by `0.NN`, and annotations like `(0.36)` or `(0.36, Lumen's)`.

tests.covers_criterion: 1: committed DESIGN.md equals the in-memory build byte for byte. 2: a node --test drift test fails on any difference, and importing and building writes no file. 3: a root npm script runs the generator and leaves an unchanged tree unchanged. It also covers the determinism constraint (same output from another checkout path).

4: nine sections in order. 5: colour roles per theme with values and purpose, plus every registry product and its accent. 6: typography, spacing, radius and motion values equal the tokens, and changing the build input changes the output. 7: signature components, with the bezel card chosen but not shipped. 8: four effect families, one meaning each. 9: every do-not-converge row. 10: no dates, owner annotations or version history, with a reason beside each rule (checked structurally). 11: README row and package files list.

result.notes:
I could not run the tests (no command tool). I checked the parsing assumptions by reading the sources. All tests should fail on the current code because the generator, DESIGN.md, the npm script and the README row are missing.

The CDR does not name the build API or the file layout, so the tests fix this contract:

**API and script**
- `scripts/gen-design-md.mjs` exports a synchronous `buildDesignMd({ tokens } = {})` that returns the whole file as a string.
- `tokens` is a parsed `sondalab.tokens.json` and defaults to `loadTokens()`. An override must reach the typography, spacing, radius and motion values, with no state kept between calls. The tests change only `shared.font`, `text`, `space`, `radius` and `motion`.
- Importing the module must write nothing, so write only behind a main-module guard. The build must work under Node's permission model with read access only: no writes and no child processes.
- One root npm script must be exactly `node scripts/gen-design-md.mjs`.
- The generator may read only `sondalab.tokens.json`, `package.json`, `scripts/`, `docs/` and `packages/ui-kit/`, because the tests run it in a temporary copy of those paths. In that copy, it must change no file other than restoring DESIGN.md.

**Headings**
- The nine sections are `## ` headings, in order. Their titles must contain:
  1. "brand" and "voice"
  2. "colour"
  3. "typography"
  4. "spacing", "radi" and "control height"
  5. "depth"
  6. "signature components"
  7. "motion"
  8. "effect famil"
  9. "do … do-not" (for example `## Do and do-not`)
- Section 9 has `### Do` and `### Do not` subsections made of list items or table rows. Each entry holds its rule and reason on one line, at least 5 words. Each do-not row keeps the trait text from `flavour.md` word for word, plus at least 3 more words.

**Values**
- Name tokens as `text-md` or `--sl-text-md`, and likewise for `font-*`, `space-*`, `radius-*` and `motion-*`. Put the value, verbatim from the JSON, on the same line. This includes every key in those five groups, including the font stacks and the long spring `linear()`.
- Colour roles use the theme CSS names (`bg-canvas`, `status-info`, `accent-default` and so on). Every hex or rgba value in the three theme files must appear in the colour section on a line naming its role. For each role, at least one such line also needs a purpose of at least 2 words. Expression values such as light `text-on-accent` are not checked.
- Each registry product has one line with its id and both its light and dark accent hex, with `inherits` resolved.

**Other sections**
- In signature components, the bezel card text (from its first mention to the next `###`) says "chosen" and "not shipped" or "not yet shipped". Put it last or under its own `###`, and do not use "not shipped" earlier in the section.
- Each effect meaning uses the phrase from the L6 "X means *…*" sentence in `design-language.md`. It sits on a line naming the family, or under that family's `###` heading, with one meaning per line.
- DESIGN.md must not contain the words "owner" or "ruling" or any ISO date. This also applies to text taken from `flavour.md`.

**Not tested or only partly tested**
- Criterion 12 (no CSS or token change, existing tests still pass) has no new test, because it already holds on the current code. Check it with `npm test` and the diff.
- "A short reason next to each rule" is only checked by minimum entry length, so it still needs human review.
- The `gen:tokens` chain wiring mentioned in the intent is not tested.
- The drift test the CDR calls `scripts/design-md-drift.test.mjs` is `scripts/design-md-drift.cdr0002.test.mjs` here, because of the required file tag. A second copy is not needed.
